narrative.overview: Web Ink is an Operate interface for local web and PDF annotation. Document identity, local-data boundaries, and current state stay legible while decoration recedes.
keyCharacteristics: Document identity and local-data scope appear before secondary controls.
State uses fill, outline, and labels together.
PDF paper remains white while the workspace theme changes around it.

rules.name: Accent-For-State Rule
rules.body: Reserve accent roles for focus, selection, and explicit active state; committed actions use the primary pair.

rules.name: Quiet-Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep rows and chrome flat at rest; lift only transient or selected surfaces.

dos: Do use paired semantic roles in light and dark.
Do label state as well as color it.
Do preserve white PDF paper and honor reduced motion.
donts: Don't use annotation colors as the global accent.
Don't add a second reader bar, remote font, or decorative imagery.
Don't treat prototype or CSS as browser acceptance.
